diagnostic_scope: Descriptive initial-condition slices, not evidence of optimal individual potion/block actions.
interpretation: Exploratory representation plus capacity comparison, conditional on two learner seeds and the fixed campaign-derived validation population; no test evaluation or automatic promotion.

protocol.primary: Final 250k sampled combat wins with ordinary/elite/boss equally weighted; both learner seeds reported.
protocol.scope: Exact continuation, same corpus/vocabulary/rewards/source and paired validation action seeds. No new corpus or test evaluation.
protocol.selection: Fixed final 250k budget; intermediate points descriptive, no adaptive stopping or automatic promotion.
protocol.statistics: 10000 paired campaign-cluster bootstrap draws; source campaign is resampled jointly across both fixed learner seeds and action repeats. Report per-seed and aggregate results. Pilot uncertainty is conditional on these two learner seeds.

semantic-review.json.findings: No remaining blockers. Exact resume,16-worker/4-thread runtime, provenance, bounded cleanup, paired validation, campaign bootstrap, saved checkpoint restoration and existing MLflow run identities reviewed. Fixed parent-directory creation, episode cursor attribute, and correct accounting for legitimate skipped updates before protocol preparation.

owner_plan_verification.scope: Plan construction matches all original50k validation cases, modes, seeds and bundles; no games replayed. Parent-directory publication exercised in a temporary output.

semantic-review.json.reviewer_checks: AST parsed three scripts and checked original evaluation shapes and planned totals. No gameplay, training or edits.
